opening.argument: The presentation describes Forsage as a paid, slot-based matrix: registration requires 0.05 ETH, additional slots are purchased, and invited partners are placed below the participant. It then links those placements to direct wallet payments, stating that a partner’s slot purchase “100% of it goes directly to your personal Ethereum wallet.” Continued payments require an upgrade, while opening a new slot each week is said to generate as much as 613.35 ETH on X3 and 817 ETH on X4. The presentation also promises passive income for life from activated slots. These are substantial, recruitment-dependent earnings claims; the evidence does not establish that such outcomes occurred or are attainable, but the described pay-in, placement, and payout structure supports the stated position.
